title: No appeal from order under section 81(1) pursuant to mediation under section 80

content.scenario: A consumer files an appeal with the State Commission, but the order was passed under section 81(1) by the District Commission pursuant to a settlement by mediation under section 80.
content.outcome: No appeal shall lie from any order passed under sub-section (1) of section 81 by the District Commission pursuant to a settlement by mediation under section 80.

user_queries: What happens if an order is passed under section 81(1) by the District Commission?
Can an appeal be filed with the State Commission if the order was passed under section 81(1)?
How does the mediation under section 80 affect the appeal process?
